description_en: Upgrades the database kernel of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun sddp upgrade-kernel-version --product-id 5 --product-code RDS --instance-id 'rm-2ze1abcdefgh****' --upgrade-time MaintainTime --switch-time 1893456000000 --kernel-version rds_20220731 --lang zh --api-version 2026-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeKernelVersion

parameters.help_en: The product type identifier. Valid values: 5: RDS. 8: POLARDB. 27: PolarDBX2. If you specify both ProductId and ProductCode, they must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If you specify both ProductCode and ProductId, they must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance identity. You can obtain this value from the Items[].InstanceId field in the ListDataMaskingInstances response
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The execution time for the kernel upgrade. Valid values: Immediate: Executes the upgrade immediately. MaintainTime: Executes the upgrade during the maintenance window. SpecifyTime: Executes the upgrade at a specified time. PolarDB-X 2.0 does not support SpecifyTime
parameters.help_zh: 内核升级的执行时机。Immediate：立即执行；MaintainTime：维护窗口执行；SpecifyTime：指定时间执行。PolarDB-X 2.0 不支持 SpecifyTime
parameters.name: upgrade_time

parameters.help_en: The specified upgrade time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. Specify this parameter only when UpgradeTime is set to SpecifyTime. The time must be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 指定升级时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。仅 UpgradeTime=SpecifyTime 时填写，且必须晚于当前时间
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en: The target Milvus version. You can obtain this value from the KernelVersions[].KernelVersion field in the ListMiniEngineVersions response
parameters.help_zh: 目标内核版本，从 ListMiniEngineVersions 的 KernelVersions[].KernelVersion 获取
parameters.name: kernel_version

parameters.help_en: The language of the response description. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate the API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
